human_instruction: Implement a deterministic checkpoint command that runs QA and validate-json before committing. The command must only commit explicitly provided files. It must return JSON-compatible output including issue_id, commit_message, committed, commit_hash, pushed, and updated_files. Implement --push support, but pushing must only happen when --push is explicitly provided. Do not close issues automatically.
forbidden_actions: Do not run git add . or commit unspecified files.
Do not push unless --push is explicitly provided.
Do not close backlog issues automatically.
Do not modify docs/state/backlog.json or docs/state/current-project.json from checkpoint.
